title: Ovidio Guzmán's Sentencing Hearing Postponed a Seventh Time, to October 28, 2026
detail: Judge Sharon Johnson Coleman cancelled Ovidio Guzmán López's July 27, 2026 Chicago hearing and rescheduled it three months out, to October 28, 2026 at 1:30 PM — the seventh postponement of his sentencing since his July 2025 guilty plea. The judge did not publicly disclose a reason, but the delay is widely attributed to the court's continued review of U.S. prosecutors' reports on the scope of Ovidio's cooperation. The October hearing will set the timing for final sentencing rather than deliver it. Under his plea deal, Ovidio agreed to forfeit $80 million; any sentence reduction for cooperation remains undetermined.
